```{r}

  eval = TRUE

# improve digit and NA display 
options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = '')

# load packages
library(tidyverse)
```

There are 77 files for each dataframe, so I needed to figure out a way to make a vector for them. That way read_csv could read all 77 and put them together already: https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/base/versions/3.6.2/topics/list.files. 

```{r}
list.files("../raw_data")

details_files <- list.files("../raw_data", pattern = "^details.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
length(details_files)

fatal_files <- list.files("../raw_data", pattern = "^fatal.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
length(details_files)

details_data <- read_csv(details_files)

fatal_data <- read_csv(fatal_files)

storm_data <- left_join(details_data, fatal_data, join_by(EVENT_ID))

storm_fatal_data <- left_join(fatal_data, details_data, join_by(EVENT_ID))
```
```{r}
#save this data as csv files in our folder
write_csv(storm_fatal_data, "C:/Users/Marie Wheeler/Documents/stat231/marriage_mammoths/data/storm_fatal_combined.csv")
```

```{r}
#shortening dataset
storm_fatal_format <- storm_fatal_data |>
  select(!c(FAT_YEARMONTH, FAT_DAY, FAT_TIME, BEGIN_YEARMONTH, BEGIN_DAY, BEGIN_TIME, END_YEARMONTH, END_DAY, END_TIME, SOURCE, CZ_TYPE, WFO, CATEGORY, BEGIN_DATE_TIME, END_DATE_TIME))

#trying geospatial data
data_geo_start <- storm_fatal_format |>
  drop_na(BEGIN_LON) |>
  drop_na(BEGIN_LAT) |>
  st_as_sf(coords=c("BEGIN_LON","BEGIN_LAT"),crs=4326)

data_geo_end <- storm_fatal_format |>
  drop_na(END_LON) |>
  drop_na(END_LAT) |>
  st_as_sf(coords=c("END_LON","END_LAT"),crs=4326)

```

```{r}
#adding to state data
#need to sum up things we are interested in
us_states <- maps::map("state"
                    , plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE) |>
  st_as_sf() 

states_df <- us_states |>
  rename(STATE = ID)

storm_fatal_states <- storm_fatal_format |>
  mutate(STATE = str_to_lower(STATE)) |>
  left_join(states_df, by = "STATE")

```
